ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, B is marked on an island in the southern sea area of China, and the outline of the island matches Hainan Island; from near B there are solid arrows pointing outward, and the legend explains that the solid arrows represent “agricultural product output direction.” The figure also uses dashed arrows to represent the direction of industrial transfer. Then reason: According to the island location and shape of B, it can be judged that B is Hainan Island. Hainan Island has a low latitude and sufficient heat, and is an important supply area of winter vegetables and tropical melons and fruits in China; the question asks to fill in the first of the two categories of agricultural products of place B, so “vegetables” should be filled in.

raw_record.question_text:

<image1>

According to the figure, the agricultural product varieties of place B mainly include two categories. Please fill in the first category: ____

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中B是位于我国南部海域的岛屿，实线箭头表示其农产品向外输出。再推理：根据B的岛屿位置和形状判断B为海南岛。结合地理常识，海南岛热量充足，是我国冬季蔬菜和热带瓜果的重要供应地，题目要求填写两类中的第一类，因此填“蔬菜”。
